scope: Doubao disfluency and organization static follow-up; no app execution, private data or network requests
method: REA native target opened and closed. A new function query timed out at 240000 ms and returned no pseudocode; no identical retry. New DBD observations use bounded Apple LLVM disassembly with instruction bytes independently compared to original artifact. They are not invented REA Evidence IDs.

ranges.note: Bounded ASR decoder configuration instructions; enable_disfluency parsed into object+0x1e9
Bounded cleanup routine handling disfluency markers and ITN; semantic explanation is static inference
Completed handler identified by its prologue and handleCompleted diagnostic; unwind entries enclose several routines
Preference key mapping surface only; not proof of active filler removal

findings.observed: Configuration key enable_disfluency controls byte +0x1e9; a missing configuration value sets it true in this parser. That field or adjacent ITN field enables a result cleanup call. The helper detects UTF-8 〈/〉 boundaries, splits internal text at | and compares the suffix with a/A; these branches replace the entire marked span with an empty string, while another branch keeps the text portion without markers.
findings.inference: An annotation-based disfluency cleanup mechanism exists inside the packaged speech decoder, alongside separate ITN processing. It operates on spans rather than directly matching a visible dictionary of words.
findings.unknown: Origin of annotations, a/A semantic taxonomy, active model/configuration, actual reachability and natural-speech outcomes are not established.

findings.observed: Builder selects /api/v2/ai/text_organization and constructs five application-specific dictionary entries: query, scene=6, stream=true, space_at_cn_en_nb and space_at_newline. No per-word filler list or language field is encoded in these five entries.
findings.unknown: Scene numeric meaning, shared-network augmentation/encryption, server prompts/model and whether contextID travels through another layer are unresolved.

findings.observed: Completed handler checks request identity, phase/decision/no-rewrite state, nonempty content and cancels the result timeout before producing a result. Diagnostic distinguishes scene.completed.empty_content. No lexical coverage ratio or per-language filler-word rejection is present in this bounded handler.
findings.unknown: This is not a whole-program negative search; other handlers/server policies may impose additional validation.

findings.observed: Shipped preference key audio.filler_word_removal_mode and reflection name fillerWordRemovalMode exist. The key mapping returns the literal; settings helper contains the same key.
findings.unknown: Mapping to the decoder enable_disfluency flag and active setting/default were not established.

searchBoundary.packagedTextSearch: Declared .json/.txt/.strings files under app Contents, under 200000 bytes and UTF-8 decodable; no matching prompt document found. This excludes other formats, encrypted resources and remote content.
searchBoundary.languages: No controlled multilingual transcription/cleanup run performed.

limitations: New DBD IDs are ordinary local static observations. Static reconstructed branch behavior is not a runtime result.
Unwind ranges can enclose several routines; records are bounded instruction ranges, not a claim of complete Ghidra function analysis.
SDK classes such as SpeechDisfluency and preference names do not prove the app uses all such APIs.
No checkpoint, language coverage, prompt, server-side rule or quality metric was recovered.
